# Cocosol Surf Lessons

> Surf school in Cocoa Beach, Florida offering private, group, kids and coaching
> surf lessons, plus multi-day surf camps and packages. Certified local
> instructors, small groups, all gear included, beginner-friendly waves near
> Cocoa Beach Pier. Rated 4.9/5 from 88 reviews. Open daily 9:00-17:00.

## Lessons & Services
- [Private Surf Lessons](https://cocosolsurf.com/private-surf-lessons-cocoa-beach): 1-on-1 coaching with a dedicated certified instructor, all levels. From $75.
- [Group Surf Lessons](https://cocosolsurf.com/group-surf-lessons-cocoa-beach): Small-group lessons, social and lower-cost, all gear included.
- [Kids Surf Lessons](https://cocosolsurf.com/kids-surf-lessons-cocoa-beach): Ocean-safety-first lessons for children with experienced instructors.
- [Surf Coaching](https://cocosolsurf.com/surf-coaching-cocoa-beach): Ongoing coaching to refine technique for intermediate and advanced surfers.
- [Surf Camp](https://cocosolsurf.com/surf-camp-cocoa-beach): Multi-session surf camp in Cocoa Beach.
- [Surf Packages](https://cocosolsurf.com/surf-packages-cocoa-beach): Multi-day lesson packages for faster progression.

## Blog
- [Beginner's Guide to Surfing](https://cocosolsurf.com/blog/beginners-guide-to-surfing): What to expect, how to stand up, what to wear, choosing a lesson type.

- [Surfing Near Orlando](https://cocosolsurf.com/blog/surfing-near-orlando): Planning a surf trip to the coast from Orlando.
